audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own whys[]: level 1 and level 6 were credited to Ryze where whys[0]/whys[4] describe a neutral stage, and levels 3, first item and two items were credited to Tahm Kench where whys[2]/whys[5] explicitly call them Ryze's windows. The page also called a 51% matchup 'Favoured — difficulty 4/10' with diff HARD.
audit.why: The lane is close: Ryze's rotation out-cycles Thick Skin's regeneration at level 3 and again at the first mana item; everything else is attrition. Packet: Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 6 -> Skill and rows 2, 5 -> Ryze as matched pairs with ratings; diff -> EVEN, tone -> the repo's even amber, diffRating -> 5.5/10, carryRating -> 6/10, both difficulty lines and the tldr rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[6].why were Ryze-favoured filler that contradicted their corrected 'Skill' side.
audit.why: Realm Warp adds no 1v1 damage, and at two items his health-stacking sustain reabsorbs your burst — the value moves to roams and teamfights.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) The page said 'Q tongue stun' as if Tongue Lash stuns on contact. Riot's text: it applies a stack of An Acquired Taste, and stuns only 'if the champion already has 3 stacks', consuming them — the same three stacks that unlock Devour. (b) Abyssal Dive was described as 'his escape and re-engage' with no range or cooldown; it is a 1000-1200 range gap-closer with a knockup on a 21s rank-1 cooldown, against a Ryze with no dash. (c) Thick Skin's ACTIVE — converting all stored damage into a shield on a 3-second cooldown — was never mentioned; the page only ever called it a 'grey-health passive'.
audit.why: The stack count is the whole safety rule in this lane: at two stacks you can still walk away, at three you are stunned and eaten. And a player told the W is an escape will happily stand at 900 range thinking they are outside his engage.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, spikes[2].text and wants.foe[0] rewritten with the stack condition, the Dive's real range/cooldown/knockup, and Thick Skin's active shield.

audit.why: The needs-antiheal interaction is already covered by report[8].t; the shield-absorbs-burst interaction is now covered by the Thick Skin active added to wants.foe[0].
